authorship: Independent reviewer; authored and source-checked before inspecting this batch's implementation. Supervisor saved returned questions verbatim and compacted expected points.
scope: 15 fresh practical questions. Grade complete answers, not evidence status. Current guidance does not establish arbitrary historical or future law.

cases.question: Using current ACRA guidance, please handle these separately. Alpha Pte Ltd was incorporated on 12 August 2026 and has only one director: when must it appoint a secretary, and can that director do both jobs? Beta Pte Ltd's secretary resigned on 2 October 2026 and its replacement was appointed on 20 October: what changes must Beta report, and does its short vacancy remove the reporting requirement?
expected: Alpha: six months, 12/02/2027 under current rule; sole director cannot also be secretary.
Beta: report resignation and appointment separately within 14 days each; short vacancy does not waive reporting.
Keep the two companies' dates separate.

cases.question: Our established private subsidiary meets the small-company revenue and assets limits in 2025 and 2026, but we have not checked 2024. Our overseas parent owns several much larger subsidiaries. Does that prove our 2026 accounts need no audit, and would audit exemption also remove financial-statement filing?
expected: Current and preceding-year figures do not prove immediate past two FY test.
Assess subsidiary and whole consolidated group including foreign entities.
Audit exemption does not automatically remove preparation or filing.
forbidden: Current plus last FY automatically qualifies.

cases.question: Our dormant, unlisted Singapore company is still live in Bizfile. It had assets of S$620,000 halfway through the financial year but only S$200,000 at year end. Can it use the dormant relevant company exemption from preparing statements, and can it stop filing annual returns?
expected: S$500,000 assets test applies at any time during FY; peak exceeds it.
Other section 201A conditions matter.
Live dormant company still files AR.
forbidden: Dormancy alone removes statements or AR.

cases.question: Our non-listed Singapore private company's year ended on 30 September 2026. It has no overseas branch register, has not dispensed with its AGM and has no AGM exemption. Under the presently published rules, what are its usual AGM and annual-return deadlines? Is the September FYE a request to apply September's historical law?
expected: FYE is an obligation fact, not historical-law cutoff; future workflow under current guidance differs from future-law assurance.

cases.question: Two ordinary Singapore-incorporated companies must file financial statements now, and neither falls into a special filing category. Both are non-publicly accountable. A has revenue and total assets of S$450,000 each; B has revenue of S$450,000 and assets of S$520,000. Do they use the same XBRL format, and what PDF attachment does A need?
expected: A: both size tests met; Simplified XBRL plus directors-authorised PDF.
B: assets test fails; Full XBRL on stated exclusion of special categories.
Do not borrow A's assets for B.

cases.question: For CPF wage classification, employee A's September pay is contractually payable on 10 October, while employee B's September pay is contractually payable on 20 October. Are both Ordinary Wages merely because both relate to September employment?
expected: OW requires relevant-month employment and payable by14th following month.
A meets timing; B is AW for month; classify independently and AW not exempt.

cases.question: In October 2026, one employee has S$8,700 of Ordinary Wages and a separate annual bonus. Is the CPF-able monthly OW base S$8,700, and does capping OW also prove that none of the bonus attracts CPF?
expected: OW capped S$8000 in2026.
Separate AW ceiling102000 less annual OW subject CPF per employer.
Exact bonus contribution needs remaining ceiling and rate facts.
forbidden: OW ceiling used as AW ceiling.

cases.question: Employee A turns 60 on 31 October 2026. Employee B turns 60 on 1 November 2026. Do both move to the next CPF age band for November payroll? Please explain the timing without guessing either employee's citizenship or contribution rate.
expected: Next band first day month after birthday month.
Rates need citizenship/SPRyear/wage facts.

cases.question: Two Employment Act-covered employees leave on 30 October 2026. A resigned and served the full notice; B resigned without serving the required notice. May we pay both final salaries seven days later just because their last day is the same?
expected: A last day; B within7days of last day.
Separate circumstances; do not assume tax-clearance facts.

cases.question: A public holiday falls on a day that is employee A's non-working day but employee B's contractual rest day. Neither works that day and both are covered by the Employment Act. Can we simply give both the same treatment without checking their schedules?
expected: A another day off or extra day's salary gross rate.
B next working day paid public holiday.
Use respective actual schedules.

cases.question: Company A's FYE was 31 July 2026, revenue S$4 million and tax-adjusted ECI S$10,000. Separately, company B's FYE was 31 August 2026, revenue S$4 million and ECI nil before exemptions. Under current general IRAS guidance, can either omit ECI, and what filing deadline applies where filing is needed?
expected: A positive ECI fails waiver; usual deadline31/10/2026 absent separate exemption.
B meets general waiver on stated facts.
Keep ECI and FYE owned by company.
forbidden: Book loss substitutes for tax ECI.

cases.question: Assume a non-director service payment requires WHT filing. There is no contract; the invoice is dated 8 August 2026, arrived on 2 September, offers 60-day credit and was paid on 10 October. Nothing was credited earlier to a recipient-designated account. Which date starts the filing timetable, and what is the deadline?
expected: No contract uses invoice date, ignores credit terms.
Do not invent liability or rate.

cases.question: Please assess two staff medical expenses separately for GST. Both relate to a work-related health risk and are required by Singapore written law; neither falls under WICA or a collective agreement. Expense A was incurred on 30 September 2021 and expense B on 2 October 2021. Does the same post-2021 exception apply to both?
expected: Work-risk written-law limb starts01/10/2021.
A before boundary; B meets stated limb/date subject ordinary conditions.
Keep dates independent.

cases.question: Our VCFM is preparing its Form 25A annual declaration, but a colleague says that filing it also settles every return for the funds we manage, including any QDC requirement. What does the current VCFM toolkit actually establish, and can you confirm the precise QDC obligation from that alone?
expected: Specified manager-level annual info Form25A within1month FYE.
Toolkit does not establish all fund returns.
QDC precise form/applicability/deadline requires own evidence/facts.

cases.question: A VCFM may soon be unable to meet its obligations and is considering suspending payments. Its FYE is still several months away. May it leave this for the annual Form 25A, and does the current toolkit specify a prescribed notification form for the material financial deterioration?
expected: Immediate notification of material adverse financial position including likely inability/impending suspension.
No prescribed form; toolkit identifies MAS-Tx incident/breach route.
25A does not postpone separate duty.
